instruction: Remove the last slide from the lecture presentation on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to insert speaker notes from notes.docx into presentation slides. Opened VLC by mistake, then navigated slides in Impress, opened View menu to access Notes view, browsed through slides, but failed to complete note insertion across 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress slides, open View menu, click on text elements, browse slide panel, right-click context menus
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed at the complex multi-app workflow: reading notes.docx content and pasting into Impress notes sections. Spent too many turns navigating without successfully inserting any notes.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single slide management operation (delete) that only requires slide panel navigation and context menu interaction, which the model demonstrated
metadata.explanation: Task requires deleting the last slide (slide 7) from the 7-slide presentation. Getter reads total slide count from the pptx. Metric checks if count equals expected value of 6.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads pptx file via python-pptx and returns slide count
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (direct access to rules dict via expected.get('expected_count'))
Expected value of 6 is correct (7 original slides minus 1 deleted = 6)
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state

Minor coverage gap: evaluator only checks slide count, not that specifically the LAST slide was removed. Deleting any slide would yield count=6 and pass. However, this is a pragmatic and standard approach for this type of task.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: For stricter verification, could additionally check content of the last remaining slide (slide 6) to confirm it matches the original slide 6, not the original slide 7. This would confirm the last slide was specifically removed rather than an arbitrary slide.
